actual_data.parameter_product: finite eta-Leibniz sum over k+l=m with binomial(m,k)

layer.capability: Materializes raw quad1(x1) and complete slow1(x1) as mixed-scale coefficient jets, preserving ordinary Lambda^0..Lambda^-4 and normalized a^2 Lambda^-1..Lambda^-3 channels.
forbidden_promotions: caller-supplied or fitted Lambda, amplitude, pressure, coefficient, or surrogate x1 data
mixing terms from different x1 or SchedulePressure datum
silently truncating a nonzero channel above the declared ordinary or pressure-linear widths
creating or discarding an unrepresented pressure-pressure a^4 product
binary64 collapse of the signed-log pressure contribution
applying an outer inverseL or resolvent and calling that naturalRemainder(x1)
naturalRemainder(x1), x2, fixed-point, convergence, global AxisSpace, or paper-exact claims from this layer alone
layer.remaining_boundary: The outer angular inverseL/resolvent recombination, remaining linear angular terms, complete axial recombination, source-pressure path, naturalRemainder(x1), later Picard iterates, fixed-point convergence, derived average/pressure, NaturalProfileAssembly, global AxisSpace certification, and downstream support/moment/matching/cone checks remain unresolved.
numerical_caveats: the channel products and sums use ordinary Decimal arithmetic at precision 96; this is a numerical representation, not exact real arithmetic, interval certification, or an independent theorem proof
rounded cancellation in a channel numerator can lose digits; the implementation does not promote the truth status
the phase and amplitude logarithm retain the landed numerical quadrature boundary
pressure terms remain in normalized signed-log form and are never converted to binary64
validation beyond the bounded import and smoke check is left to the parent batch verification
